sources.primary_title: Saudi Aramco-Backed VC Prosperity7 Joins Massive $110M Round in Velaura AI at $1B+ Valuation to Build Energy-Efficient AI Computing
sources.verified_angle_summary: U.S.-based AI infrastructure company Velaura AI has raised $110 million in a Series A funding round, achieving a valuation of over $1 billion. The round was led by Seligman Ventures, with participation from Saudi Aramco-backed Prosperity7 Ventures and other prominent investors. The funding will support the development and commercialization of Velaura's low-power AI computing technologies, particularly its proprietary Titan Core platform, which aims to improve the energy efficiency of AI accelerators. This investment highlights the growing focus on energy-efficient AI solutions as the rapid expansion of generative AI drives up operating costs and pressure on power grids. The technology is also targeted at Physical AI applications, including robots and drones, where computing performance must operate within tight power and thermal constraints.
